title: Dental PPO Plans Estimate Coinsurance by Requesting Practice Network
content:
The coinsurance a pre-treatment estimate requested anew under the Dental PPO Plans (a requested estimate) is figured at follows the requesting practice's network, and so decides the estimated patient cost:
- a major-class service from a PPO in-network or Premier in-network practice is figured at the plan's in-network major percentage;
- a basic-class service from such a practice is figured at the plan's in-network basic percentage;
- a preventive-class service from such a practice is figured at the plan's in-network preventive percentage;
- a service from any other practice is figured at the plan's out-of-network percentage for its service class.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| In-network preventive | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| In-network basic | 0 | 70 | 80 | 80 | 90 | 90 |
| In-network major | 0 | 0 | 50 | 50 | 60 | 60 |
| Out-of-network preventive | 100 | 90 | 90 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Out-of-network basic | 0 | 60 | 70 | 80 | 80 | 90 |
| Out-of-network major | 0 | 0 | 40 | 50 | 50 | 60 |

All figures are percentages.

### Examples (hypothetical estimates on Value 1000)
| Service and practice | Percentage |
|---|---|
| Preventive, Premier in-network practice | 100 |
| Preventive, out-of-network practice | 90 |
| Basic, PPO in-network practice | 70 |
| Basic, out-of-network practice | 60 |
